nda2d4c5146.headline: ESB operating profit declines by a third as electricity prices come down
nda2d4c5146.summary: ESB Group reported a 34% reduction in operating profit for the first half of 2024. The fall comes as electricity prices have come down.
nda2d4c5146.why: ESB is Ireland's state-owned electricity utility, operating generation and grid networks. Its profits are sensitive to wholesale power prices and regulated network returns.

n79f9377d8e.summary: A Ministry of Finance review shows apartment sales in July 2024 rose 29% from July 2023, with new-apartment sales up 51%. Investor and first-time buyer activity also grew.
n79f9377d8e.why: Housing sales reflect household demand and credit conditions, which influence construction activity and the broader property market.

nfbc3b629e5.why: Wholesale inflation trends provide early signals of consumer price movements and influence monetary policy decisions in India.

n7d178a36aa.summary: Partnership develops AI receptionist to enhance patient access, reflecting growth in healthcare technology.

n5418c9062c.summary: Twenty Nigerian state governments borrowed a combined N446 billion amid falling internally generated revenues, with debt servicing consuming over 80% of revenue in 29 states.
n5418c9062c.why: Rising state debt and high debt servicing costs strain public finances and may affect fiscal sustainability in Nigeria.

n381e379e71.headline: Steel giant's venture fund inks tech pact on green iron
n381e379e71.summary: An Australian steel company’s venture fund has signed a technology pact with a space tech entrepreneur to develop iron production from Australian ores using green technology.

nabba9d81a1.headline: DCX Systems shares jump 5%, hit upper-circuit; What's driving the rally? | Stock Market News

nabba9d81a1.why_moved: Strong share price gains indicate improved investor confidence in DCX Systems' outlook or results.

n8ecb0bf50b.headline: Govt asks oil firms not to hike retail prices; 30 lakh tons oils imported at lower duty available
n8ecb0bf50b.summary: India’s government has asked edible oil processors not to increase retail prices following recent import duty hikes, citing sufficient stocks imported at lower duties.
n8ecb0bf50b.why: Edible oil prices affect inflation and consumer spending in India, a major global importer of cooking oils.

n813a7daded.headline: BSP seen to cut banks’ reserve requirements soon
n813a7daded.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is anticipated to reduce the reserve requirements for banks before year-end following recent interest rate cuts.

nb5aa759a80.headline: Irish farmers see 73% increase in costs in last 7 years
